decisions.retreat_format: Hybrid (in-person with remote access capability), with the schedule adjusted to ensure all required activities are accessible remotely during the 13:00–16:00 window. Full-day event with remote participation accommodations built in.
decisions.facilitator: Neutral facilitator (not a member of either merged team or their direct management chain)

commitments.detail: Retreat schedule will include remote-accessible activities during the 13:00–16:00 window, and no required activities for Imani will be scheduled outside that window. Imani's approved caregiving arrangement will be reflected in the final plan.

Leo will file a formal incident summary documenting exactly the two observed incidents of Alex publicly interrupting Sam during disagreements. Deadline: within 5 business days of this approval. The final retreat plan will also record these two incidents.
The retreat exercises will prohibit supervisor-employee pairings. Pairings will be limited to peers or cross-team members at comparable organizational levels.
Written opt-in will be collected from every participant before any conflict-repair exercise begins. Participants may decline without penalty.

A neutral facilitator external to both merged teams and their direct management chain will be engaged for the retreat. Facilitator selection to be confirmed at least 10 business days before the event.
First follow-up check-in scheduled within 2 weeks post-retreat, conducted by HR, to assess trust-building progress and surface any concerns.
Second follow-up check-in scheduled within 6 weeks post-retreat, conducted by HR, to assess sustained progress and identify any ongoing issues.
The company's trust-building event procedure memo will be attached to the event approval packet before final sign-off.
